note: FILL PROPERTY (Phase B3): a single window fills its display. An arrangement with ZERO gridlines is one window occupying the whole canvas. valid() MUST report ok:true, no violations — the one full-canvas cell claims the sole atom (claimed_atoms == nx*ny == 1), so the no-gap clause is satisfied with no empty space where a window could go. The degenerate base case of the no-gap fill property: even with one window, the display is fully covered, never a partial fill leaving dead space. Pairs with clean_2x2 (multi-cell fill) and hole_center (the RED gap proof).
